description: A fictional stun pistol game prop for a cave warden, chunky low-poly, one hand, held level with the prongs forward. One smooth slate blue-grey painted body block with wide chamfers and a rounded charcoal rear end cap. From its front two thick octagonal dark steel contact prongs reach straight forward, one above the other with a clear gap between them, each rooted in one fat charcoal collar block on the body front; between the prong roots one dished round dark steel emitter disc in a thick rim recessed in the front face. Lying lengthwise on top of the body one fat octagonal slate blue-grey capacitor cylinder with chamfered ends, held by exactly two wide charcoal clamp bands that stand on the body top. On the left flank one fat two-part charcoal slider block toward the rear and one small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel ahead of it. Under the rear of the body one squared charcoal trigger guard with a thick charcoal trigger and one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with four big diagonal ribs.
proportions: About 0.36 m long, 0.09 m wide and 0.25 m tall. (length : width : height = 4.00 : 1 : 2.78)
sides: on the LEFT flank only: the teal lamp window and the fat two-part charcoal slider block (standing proud of the body). The right flank is plain slate. The two prongs (one above the other on the centre line), the emitter disc, the capacitor and its bands, the rear cap, the trigger guard and the grip are on the centre line.
